import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Read the data
df = pd.read_csv('data.csv')

# Create a figure with multiple subplots
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 12))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Set style
sns.set_style("whitegrid")
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sleep Duration vs Quality of Sleep (scatter)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
scatter = ax1.scatter(df['Sleep Duration'], df['Quality of Sleep'], 
                     c=df['Stress Level'], cmap='YlOrRd', s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
ax1.set_xlabel('Sleep Duration (hours)', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_ylabel('Quality of Sleep', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax1.set_title('Sleep Duration vs Quality\n(colored by Stress)', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
cbar1 = plt.colorbar(scatter, ax=ax1)
cbar1.set_label('Stress Level', fontsize=9)

# 2. BMI Category distribution
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
bmi_counts = df['BMI Category'].value_counts()
ax2.bar(range(len(bmi_counts)), bmi_counts.values, color=colors[:len(bmi_counts)], edgecolor='black')
ax2.set_xticks(range(len(bmi_counts)))
ax2.set_xticklabels(bmi_counts.index, rotation=45, ha='right')
ax2.set_ylabel('Count', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax2.set_title('BMI Category Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
for i, v in enumerate(bmi_counts.values):
    ax2.text(i, v + 0.1, str(v), ha='center', fontweight='bold')

# 3. Sleep Disorder distribution
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
disorder_counts = df['Sleep Disorder'].fillna('None').value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(disorder_counts.values, labels=disorder_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', colors=colors, startangle=90,
                                     textprops={'fontsize': 9, 'fontweight': 'bold'})
ax3.set_title('Sleep Disorder Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 4. Physical Activity Level by Occupation
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
occupation_activity = df.groupby('Occupation')['Physical Activity Level'].mean().sort_values()
ax4.barh(range(len(occupation_activity)), occupation_activity.values, color=colors[2], edgecolor='black')
ax4.set_yticks(range(len(occupation_activity)))
ax4.set_yticklabels(occupation_activity.index, fontsize=9)
ax4.set_xlabel('Avg Physical Activity Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax4.set_title('Physical Activity by Occupation', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 5. Stress Level vs Heart Rate
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
ax5.scatter(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], c=colors[4], s=100, alpha=0.6, edgecolors='black')
z = np.polyfit(df['Stress Level'], df['Heart Rate'], 1)
p = np.poly1d(z)
ax5.plot(df['Stress Level'].sort_values(), p(df['Stress Level'].sort_values()), 
         "r--", alpha=0.8, linewidth=2, label='Trend')
ax5.set_xlabel('Stress Level', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_ylabel('Heart Rate', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax5.set_title('Stress Level vs Heart Rate', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax5.legend()

# 6. Daily Steps distribution
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
ax6.hist(df['Daily Steps'], bins=15, color=colors[5], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax6.axvline(df['Daily Steps'].mean(), color='red', linestyle='--', linewidth=2, label=f'Mean: {df["Daily Steps"].mean():.0f}')
ax6.set_xlabel('Daily Steps', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax6.set_title('Daily Steps Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')
ax6.legend()

# 7. Age distribution
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
ax7.hist(df['Age'], bins=10, color=colors[6], edgecolor='black', alpha=0.7)
ax7.set_xlabel('Age', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_ylabel('Frequency', fontsize=10, fontweight='bold')
ax7.set_title('Age Distribution', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# 8. Correlation heatmap
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
numeric_cols = ['Age', 'Sleep Duration', 'Quality of Sleep', 'Physical Activity Level', 
                'Stress Level', 'Heart Rate', 'Daily Steps']
corr_matrix = df[numeric_cols].corr()
sns.heatmap(corr_matrix, annot=True, fmt='.2f', cmap='coolwarm', center=0, 
            square=True, ax=ax8, cbar_kws={'shrink': 0.8})
ax8.set_title('Correlation Matrix of Numeric Variables', fontsize=11, fontweight='bold')

# Main title
fig.suptitle('Sleep Health and Lifestyle Dataset - Comprehensive Analysis', 
             fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

plt.savefig('output.png', dpi=300, bbox_inches='tight')
plt.close()
